name: Réunion
prevalence_note: Local reporting has documented fraudulent undelivered-parcel SMS waves on Réunion, and the island's DEETS warns about SMS promising a prize that leads to costly contact.
cross_border_note: Réunion shares +262 with Mayotte and receives many mainland French (+33) calls; Mauritius (+230) and Madagascar (+261) numbers are also common nearby.

scams.name: SMS frauduleux colis non livré
scams.name_en: Fraudulent undelivered-parcel SMS circulating on Réunion
scams.signals_en: A wave of texts claims a parcel to Réunion could not be delivered and asks for a fee through a link.
scams.legit_en: Official French guidance says carriers do not demand fees by SMS link; check only on the carrier's site.
bait_tactics: Demander de quel dépôt de Saint-Denis vient le colis
Dire que seul un avis dans la boîte aux lettres sera pris en compte

scams.name: SMS promettant un gain
scams.name_en: SMS promising a prize that leads to a costly call or click
scams.signals_en: A text announces a win and urges the owner to call a number or click a link that triggers premium charges.
scams.legit_en: DEETS Réunion advises not responding to unsolicited prize SMS.
bait_tactics: Demander quel jeu a été gagné et à quelle date on y a participé
Ne pas rappeler et garder le SMS pour le signaler
